SELECT /*getJspSearchSample*/ Y.NUM ,Y.BUYER ,Y.RAV_NO ,Y.RAV_SEQ ,Y.STATUS ,Y.RFQ_USER_ID ,Y.RFQ_USER_NAME ,Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,Y.ITEM_STATUS ,Y.DESCRIPTION ,Y.SPECIFICATION ,Y.UNIT_MEASURE ,Y.MAKER_NAME ,Y.BUYER_REMARK ,Y.KEP_RAV_SEQ ,Y.KEP_BUYER_ITEM_NO ,Y.KEP_ITEM_STATUS ,Y.KEP_DESCRIPTION ,Y.KEP_SPECIFICATION ,Y.KEP_UNIT_MEASURE ,Y.KEP_MAKER_NAME ,Y.KEP_KEP_REMARK ,Y.FEEDBACK_FLAG ,Y.CONTRACT_NO ,Y.CONTRACT_SEQ ,Y.KEP_USER_ID ,Y.KEP_PHONE_NUMBER ,Y.IMAGE_KEY FROM( SELECT ROWNUM NUM ,X.BUYER ,X.RAV_NO ,X.RAV_SEQ ,X.STATUS ,X.RFQ_USER_ID ,X.RFQ_USER_NAME ,X.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,X.ITEM_STATUS ,X.DESCRIPTION ,X.SPECIFICATION ,X.UNIT_MEASURE ,X.MAKER_NAME ,X.BUYER_REMARK ,X.KEP_RAV_SEQ ,X.KEP_BUYER_ITEM_NO ,X.KEP_ITEM_STATUS ,X.KEP_DESCRIPTION ,X.KEP_SPECIFICATION ,X.KEP_MAKER_NAME ,X.KEP_UNIT_MEASURE ,X.KEP_KEP_REMARK ,X.FEEDBACK_FLAG ,X.CONTRACT_NO ,X.CONTRACT_SEQ ,X.KEP_USER_ID ,X.KEP_PHONE_NUMBER ,X.IMAGE_KEY FROM( SELECT A.BUYER ,A.RAV_NO ,A.RAV_SEQ ,A.STATUS ,A.RFQ_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.RFQ_USER_ID) AS RFQ_USER_NAME ,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,A.ITEM_STATUS ,A.DESCRIPTION ,A.SPECIFICATION ,A.UNIT_MEASURE ,A.MAKER_NAME ,A.BUYER_REMARK ,B.RAV_SEQ AS KEP_RAV_SEQ ,B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS KEP_BUYER_ITEM_NO ,B.ITEM_STATUS AS KEP_ITEM_STATUS ,B.DESCRIPTION AS KEP_DESCRIPTION ,B.SPECIFICATION AS KEP_SPECIFICATION ,B.MAKER_NAME AS KEP_MAKER_NAME ,B.UNIT_MEASURE AS KEP_UNIT_MEASURE ,B.KEP_REMARK AS KEP_KEP_REMARK ,A.FEEDBACK_FLAG AS FEEDBACK_FLAG ,NVL(B.CONTRACT_NO, '') AS CONTRACT_NO ,NVL(B.CONTRACT_SEQ, '') AS CONTRACT_SEQ ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = B.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_ID ,(SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = B.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_PHONE_NUMBER ,A.IMAGE_KEY FROM TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY A, TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY B WHERE A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.RAV_NO = B.RAV_NO(+)
AND A.RAV_NO LIKE #{st_ser_rav_no}||'%'
AND A.FEEDBACK_FLAG = #{st_fb_flag}
AND A.RAV_SEQ = 1 AND B.RAV_SEQ(+) = 2 AND ((A.ITEM_STATUS ='K' AND A.STATUS IN('C','R'))OR (A.ITEM_STATUS ='S' AND A.STATUS = 'C')) ORDER BY A.RAV_NO )X ) Y
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY SET STATUS = 'R' ,FEEDBACK_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND RAV_NO = #{st_rav_no}

INSERT INTO ICOMCART SELECT A.BUYER ,#{userid} ,B.CONTRACT_NO ,B.CONTRACT_SEQ ,'C' ,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,(SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(SEQ))+1 FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND USER_ID = #{userid} AND USE_FLAG = 'C' ) ,B.AGENT ,1 ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DATE ,B.BUYER AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE ,' ' AS REF_PR_NO ,B.TARGET_PRICE ,NULL ,B.ACCOUNT_TYPE ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL ,sysdate ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL FROM TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY A, ICOMCQDT B, ICOMBYIT C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND B.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO=B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO=C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE IN ('ABOVE', #{st_buyer} ) AND A.RAV_NO = #{st_rav_no} AND B.CONTRACT_NO = #{st_contract_no} AND B.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{st_contract_seq} AND A.ITEM_STATUS = 'K' AND A.RAV_SEQ = 2 AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('T','N')

UPDATE TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY SET STATUS = 'D' ,KEP_REMARK = KEP_REMARK ||' DELETE(USER : '||#{userid}||', DATE : ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')|| ')' WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND RAV_NO = #{st_rav_no}
UPDATE TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY SET STATUS = 'E' WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND RAV_NO = #{st_rav_no}
